text:
nina.w: Morning folks, brand-new hire here. I clicked the Okta link but it keeps looping me to a Google sign-in page for a personal account. My company email is nina.w@redwood.com. Any tips?

olivia-peopleops: Welcome Nina! :wave: Sounds like the invite was opened while signed into a personal Google account. Two quick fixes: 1) Open the invite in an incognito window, or 2) sign out of personal Google in that tab before accepting. I'll also re-send to nina.w@redwood.com in case link expired.

nina.w: Tried incognito, now Okta reached the step to enroll MFA but the browser picked an old iCloud passkey tied to my personal Apple ID. I don't want that connected to work.

sam-it: Hi Nina 1 If you don't want to use personal passkeys, choose "Set up a different authenticator" and pick "Authenticator app or security key". We support TOTP (1Password/Authy) and U2F keys (YubiKey). If you want me to disable passkey prompts from our side temporarily I can patch the policy for your enrollment.

jenna-eng: Also FYI: if you register a passkey on a personal Apple ID then later we have to remove it from the wrong account which is messy. I'd go TOTP-first for new joiners and then register a company-bound passkey after provisioning finishes.

olivia-peopleops: Resent Okta invite to nina.w@redwood.com and revoked the old one. Watch for two emails (Okta + 1Password). If 1Password doesn't show up in ~5m I'll poke the SCIM job.

nina.w: Accepted via incognito and set up TOTP in 1Password (scanned QR). Okta shows me active but I can't access the onboarding Google Drive folder yet. It says "no access".

1password-bot: 1Password: invitation delivered to nina.w@redwood.com.

sam-it: Looks like group sync hasn't applied yet. I can see you in Okta and in the "employees" SCIM group, but Google groups sync might be delayed. I'll force a sync and confirm folder share.

jenna-eng: If you need immediate access to docs for the infra repo, I can drop a temporary share. What do you need?

nina.w: Would love access to the onboarding checklist and the infra quickstart doc. Thanks!

sam-it: Forced GoogleGroups re-sync and re-applied drive shares. You should get an email from Google Drive with access. If not, logout/login to Google in browser or try opening the folder link in incognito.

nina.w: Got the Drive access. Quick question: how do I get SSH access to the infra bastion? There's a step about uploading an SSH public key but I don't see the UI.

jenn-aeng: Hey Nina, for the bastion we use a Git-backed account manager. Go to https://git.redwood.internal/ssh-keys -> create a PR with a file under /keys/nina.w.pub containing your public key, then tag @jenna-eng for review. Once merged, the deployment job adds you to the bastion group. I'll drop the PR template in the onboarding doc.

olivia-peopleops: Great closing note: if anyone else sees odd passkey behavior during Okta enrollment, ping #new-hires or DM me, we can toggle the enrollment policy per-user. Welcome again Nina! :tada:
